question: The average age of 30 students of a class is 12 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 13 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Age of new member = Old average + (New total members × Increase in average)

Old average = 12 years, New total members = 30 + 1 = 31

Increase in average = 13 − 12 = 1 year

Teacher's age = 12 + (31 × 1)

Teacher's age = 12 + 31 = 43 years

**∴ The correct answer is 43 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 30

Average age of 30 students = 12 years

Average age after including the teacher = 13 years

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total Sum ÷ Number of Items

Total Sum = Average × Number of Items

 
 30 Students
 Avg = 12 yrs

 +

 
 1 Teacher
 Age = ?

 ↓

 
 31 Members
 New Avg = 13 yrs

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total age of 30 students = 30 × 12 = 360 years

⇒ Total number of members after adding the teacher = 30 + 1 = 31

⇒ Total age of 31 members = 31 × 13 = 403 years

⇒ Age of the teacher = (Total age of 31 members) − (Total age of 30 students)

⇒ Age of the teacher = 403 − 360 = 43 years

**∴ The correct answer is 43 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When combining groups of different sizes and averages, the combined average is calculated as (N₁A₁ + N₂A₂) ÷ (N₁ + N₂).

Replacement in Average

When one member is replaced by another, the new value can be found using: New Value = Replaced Value + (Total Members × Change in Average).

Correcting an Average

If a wrong value was mistakenly used in the calculation, the Correct Average = Old Average + [(Correct Value − Incorrect Value) ÷ Total Members].
